messages:
rachel: during a restore drill i found an old archive s3://redwood-archives/2020-12/nodegroup.tar.gz that contains wrapped_blob.json and a field `vault_accessor`. looks like KMS-wrapped vault data. tagging eng-security.
\dan: thanks rachel. do not attempt to auth with it. can you confirm the KMS key id in the ciphertext header?
\rachel: header shows key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/legacy-ring/cryptoKeys/deploy-key. checksum: 9f1b... i've copied the archive to s3://security-quarantine/2020-12-nodegroup.tar.gz and set ACL private.
\oli: noted. immediate playbook: 1) check vault audit for accessor/token usage, 2) check cloudkms decrypt history for that key, 3) quarantine and scan other archives for similar artifacts. i'll take 1 and 2.
\kms-bot: cloudkms: decrypt log: deploy-key had 4 decrypts between 2020-12-01 and 2020-12-10 by serviceAccount:legacy-deploy@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. no decrypts after 2020-12-10.
\vault-bot: vault audit search: no successful auths for that accessor id. some infra-sa auths earlier but not matching accessor.
\dan: ok seems tied to old deploy. still treat as sensitive. plan: revoke accessor if found, rotate KMS key (create new-key), rewrap any active ciphertexts, and run org-wide repo/backups grep for filename `wrapped_blob.json`. assign: oli->revoke/check vault, rachel->scan backups, dan->KMS rotation + IAM tidy + ticket.
\oli: i requested operator access and performed an accessor lookup: returned a token with creation_time 2020-12-02 ttl expired. i submitted an accessor revoke anyway, API responded 204 and subsequent lookups return 404. also canceled two leases referencing that token prefix.
\rachel: found 5 other archives with wrapped_blob.json. no plaintext keys. moved them all to security-quarantine and updated incident notes.
\dan: created new-key in same ring, removed legacy-deploy SA from decrypt, granted infra-bot and ops-sre decrypt/encrypt. rewrap run for 4 live ciphertexts recorded in metadata store: success. logged steps in ops-runbook.
\oli: grep of github org: no public matches. two internal archived repos had the filename; requested deletion and scanned their histories.
\dan: actions complete: - accessor revoked (oli) - KMS rotated/rewrapped (dan) - archives quarantined (rachel) - repo takedowns requested (oli)
\rachel: added a backup pre-check to infra runbook to scan archives for `vault_token`, `vault_accessor`, or `wrapped_blob.json` before allowing uploads. PR infra#1602.
\dan: incident ticket INC-2026-198 created (P2). audit tailing on for 72h. no evidence of external compromise. closing pending any SIEM hits. :white_check_mark:
